Market today: Geopolitical uncertainty and Treasury anxiety are creating headwinds. Crucially, the tech sector faces a potential long-term demand bust from slowing computer science enrollment, which is a direct hit to your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) are deep in the red (-56%, -30%, -36% respectively) and flagged "SELL." SMCI is also down significantly (-26.85%). These are amplified by margin.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your stops, especially for the leveraged positions. Monitor broader market sentiment for any further tech weakness.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged tech/chip positions given the sector's potential headwinds.
plays: SOXL is down -56% and leveraged. Re-evaluate its stop loss (currently 200) or trim to manage deep losses and margin risk.
SMCI is down -26.85% and flagged SELL. Respect its stop at 37.3 to prevent further drawdown.
SMH is near its stop at 540. Be ready to trim as flagged if it breaks this level.
